newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Regional food protection deadline to be agreed on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Regional food protection deadline to be agreed on Monday.

text.p: Farm ministers are expected to agree on Monday a proposal to extend the transitional period for imposing new rules to protect feta cheese and other regional food products from competitors using the same brand names.

A five-year transitional period will now apply from the date on which the regional food products are officially registered instead of from the date of publication of the regulation (2081/ 92) in July 1992.
The original transitional period was due to expire in July 1997 whereas the European Commission only approved in June 1996 a first list of regional food products to be protected.
Diplomats said that the proposal could be agreed without discussion as an "A" point as there was a qualified majority in favour with only Greece and Italy opposed.
